title: Introspect the session — which bank will the gateway attribute writes to?
description: GET /api/v1/auth/me returns the claims the gateway derived from the access_token cookie. bankId is the identity every write is attributed to.
notes: Gateway: any. This is how a client discovers its own bankId, and why request bodies must never carry payer_bank_id, payer_id, owner_bank_id or requester_besu_address — those fields are deprecated and overwritten from this claim. Scenario-dependent behaviour: when the JWT carries no bank id, Scenario A substitutes the gateway's BANK_CODE here while Scenario B omits bankId entirely, so a test asserting its absence passes on B and fails on A.
